# This directory must exist.
#
# The Dockerfile's final stage does `COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public`,
# and a COPY from a stage fails outright when the source path is absent. An
# empty `public/` is enough to satisfy it; anything placed here is served at the
# site root.
#
# There is currently no static asset in here. The favicon is served by the App
# Router from `src/app/icon.svg` instead, and `robots.txt` / `sitemap.xml` are
# generated by `src/app/robots.ts` and `src/app/sitemap.ts`.
